dict.string: Mandarin DAC Bridge reads back what the Music or Spotify app plays to its DAC Bridge output, to play it to your DAC. It never listens to a microphone.
Mandarin DAC Bridge follows what the Music and Spotify apps play (title, cover, each track's sample rate), and pauses them around a change of rate.
Mandarin DAC Bridge offers your DACs to Audirvana, Mandarin and other apps on your network.
